national_raw_news.title: SEBI announces relaxation in KYC review rules for FPIs to boost ease of doing business 1 hour ago 154
national_raw_news.content: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has announced a significant relaxation in the Know Your Customer (KYC) review rules for Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) to boost the ease of doing business. Under the new guidelines issued today, the market regulator has increased the periodicity of KYC reviews for various categories of FPIs. As per the new guidelines, for Category-One FPIs from non-high-risk jurisdictions and certain high-risk entities registered under specific regulations, the KYC review will now be required only once every eight years instead of the earlier shorter timeline. For other FPI categories, including regulated entities and non-high-risk Category-Two investors, the review period has also been rationalised to every eight years, while remaining at every two years for certain remaining entities. In another major relief aimed at reducing the compliance burden, SEBI has completely dispensed with the requirement for FPIs to intimate changes in information or submit a no-change declaration at the time of continuing their registration. FPIs wishing to continue their registration for a subsequent block of three years will now only need to pay the required fees to their Designated Depository Participants (DDP) at least 15 days prior to the expiry of their validity. The regulator said that the KYC review timelines for FPIs investing exclusively in Government Securities and SWAGAT-FI FPIs will remain unchanged. These new provisions are set to come into force with effect from 1st December of this year.

national_raw_news.title: UP: HM Amit Shah urges party workers to work with full commitment tfor forthcoming assembly elections 2 hours ago 55
national_raw_news.content: Home Minister Amit Shah today said the BJP would implement the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) in Uttar Pradesh, expressing confidence that the party would return to power in the state after assembly elections next year. Addressing the BJP State Working Committee meeting in Lucknow today, he said the BJP government is as firm as Angad’s foot and could not be removed. He urged party workers to work with full commitment to secure another victory with a clear majority. He credited party workers for the BJP’s victories in the 2017 and 2022 Assembly elections. Mr. Shah said that the UCC has already been implemented in several states. Referring to 1990 firing on Ram devotees in Ayodhya during the Samajwadi party government, Mr. Shah alleged that indiscriminate firing had been ordered on devotees of Lord Ram and BJP workers. He claimed that the Samajwadi Party would remain out of power in the state for 30 years. The Home Minister lauded Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s contribution in the growth of the state saying that Uttar Pradesh has emerged as an investment hub, attracting investments worth over 50 lakh crore rupees. He added that improvements in law and order in UP had attracted investment, which in turn generated employment opportunities and eventually helped curb migration from the state. The meeting was chaired by BJP state president and Union Minister of State for Finance Pankaj Chaudhary. Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, Deputy Chief Ministers Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak, BJP state in-charge Vinod Tawde and national general secretary Smriti Irani and other members of the state executive committee attended the meeting.

national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will be on a two-day visit to Gujarat, beginning today. Mr Modi will lay the foundation stone, inaugurate and dedicate to the nation various development projects worth over 14 thousand crore rupees in Banaskantha today. The Prime Minister will lay the foundation stone of Ahmedabad Metro Phase-2A (Airport Extension) and Phase-2B (GIFT City Extension). He will also release the 24th instalment under PM-KISAN, amounting to 19 thousand crore rupees. He will also visit the Embryo Transfer Technology-In Vitro Fertilisation Laboratory and the Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre cattle farm in Banaskantha. The Centre will strengthen bovine breeding, genetic upgradation and advanced reproductive technologies, accelerating breed improvement by 10 to 20 times. Thereafter, the Prime Minister will travel to Ekta Nagar, Kevadia and inaugurate Bharat Parv 2026. Tomorrow, Prime Minister Modi will offer floral tributes at the Statue of Unity. Mr Modi will lay the foundation stone, inaugurate and dedicate to the nation various development projects worth over four hundred crore rupees in Ekta Nagar. The projects include a sewage and water treatment plant, facade lighting, the upgradation of Narmada Ghat, and the Rainforest, among others. The Prime Minister will also participate in the Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrations commemorating the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

national_raw_news.title: 14th International Tourism Mart inaugurated in Arunachal Pradesh's Tawang - ANI News
national_raw_news.content: 14th International Tourism Mart inaugurated in Arunachal Pradesh's Tawang Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर 14th International Tourism Mart inaugurated in Arunachal Pradesh's Tawang ANI | Updated: Oct 30, 2026 03:59 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], October 30 (ANI): The 14th edition of the International Tourism Mart (ITM), organised by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, in association with the Government of Arunachal Pradesh and other North Eastern States, commenced on Thursday at Tawang , Arunachal Pradesh . The three-day Mart, being held from October 29 to 31, aims to showcase the tourism potential of the eight North Eastern States and strengthen business engagement with domestic and international tourism markets. The inaugural session was held in the presence of Gajendra Singh Shekhawat , Union Minister for Tourism and Culture; Suresh Gopi, Union Minister of State for Tourism and Petroleum & Natural Gas; Sukanta Majumdar, Union Minister of State for Education and Development of North Eastern Region (DoNER); Pema Khandu, Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh ; and Prem Singh Tamang, Chief Minister of Sikkim. Tourism Ministers from the North Eastern States, senior officials of the Central and State Governments, international and domestic tourism stakeholders and representatives of the travel industry were also present. Addressing the inaugural session, Union Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat emphasised that the International Tourism Mart has evolved beyond a promotional platform into an important avenue for tourism partnerships and business opportunities. He stated, “ITM is not merely a tourism marketplace; it is a platform for building partnerships, generating business opportunities and creating a shared vision for the growth of tourism in the North East Region.” Highlighting the immense potential of the region, the Minister said that its rich biodiversity, cultural heritage, spiritual traditions and natural landscapes offer distinctive opportunities for adventure, nature-based and experiential tourism. He particularly emphasised the potential of adventure tourism, music festivals and concert tourism to attract new visitor segments, encourage longer stays and generate economic opportunities for local communities. He also called for developing tourism experiences with appropriate safety standards, community participation and environmental safeguards. The Minister highlighted the Government’s continued focus on improving connectivity, tourism infrastructure and destination experiences in the North Eastern Region. He also underlined the Ministry’s support for tourism promotion through domestic and international travel fairs, festivals, digital platforms and familiarisation visits, along with skill development initiatives to create employment opportunities for local youth. Image Credit: ANI SHARE Key Takeaways AI Summary Analyzing article... India Post and UTI Mutual Fund have extended their existing partnership to expand doorstep Know Your Customer (KYC) verification services for mutual fund investors across India, particularly in remote and underserved areas. According to a release issued by the Ministry of Communications on Thursday, the expanded collaboration aims to simplify investor verification, improve access to mutual fund services and strengthen financial inclusion. "Under the Pan-India KYC Verification Project, India Post will leverage its extensive postal network and last-mile connectivity to facilitate Know Your Customer (KYC) verification at investors' doorsteps, including in remote and underserved areas," the ministry said. The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) extending the existing agreement was signed by Adnan Ahmed, Chief General Manager, Parcel & CCS Directorate, Department of Posts, and Vetri Subramaniam, Managing Director and CEO of UTI Asset Management Company Limited, in Mumbai on Thursday. The expanded partnership builds on an earlier KYC remediation initiative that helped investors complete pending verification requirements and address documentation gaps. "Building on the earlier KYC remediation initiative, which helped investors complete pending KYC requirements, improve compliance and address documentation gaps, the expanded collaboration is expected to strengthen investor servicing, encourage wider participation in mutual funds and support uninterrupted access to mutual fund investments," the release stated. India Post has already been providing doorstep KYC verification services for mutual fund investors. According to an earlier Ministry of Communications release issued in April 2025, India Post had completed over 5 lakh KYC verifications for UTI and the Specified Undertaking of the Unit Trust of India (SUUTI). The Department of Posts subsequently signed similar agreements with Nippon India Mutual Fund in April 2025 and SBI Mutual Fund later that month. In July 2025, India Post also entered into an agreement with the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) to facilitate KYC verification for mutual fund investors through its network of over 1.64 lakh post offices.
